result.question: How did Uzziah trespass against Yahweh?

readings.answer: By entering the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
readings.support: he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense

assessments.reason: The passage says he "entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense," which matches the key’s "burned incense in Yahweh’s house" (temple = house).

result.reason: The text explicitly states he entered the temple to burn incense, matching the key’s description.
